items.text: haan ji

items.text: nahi ji

items.context: Paise kab transfer huye the aapke account se
items.text: kal kiya tha
mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua
main surat me rehta hu par transaction mumbai ka dikh raha hai
maine ye transaction kab konsa din hua pata nahi
mera naam ramesh kumar hai aur ye transaction unauthorized hai
guna city se transaction hua hai par mujhe uske baare me kuch pata nahi
mujhe turant mera paise wapas chahiye kyunki ye fraud lag raha hai
mera account number 1234567890 se paise kat gaye bina mere janne

items.context: Jab transaction hua tha uska time aur date batayenge kya
items.text: transaction ki date aur time bata sakte hain aap

items.context: Kitne paise kat gaye hain aapke account se
items.text: kya transaction ka amount batayenge jisse aapko doubt hai

items.context: Kya aapka address transaction location se match karta hai
items.text: main delhi ka rehne wala hu lekin transaction chennai se hua hai

items.context: Aapka account number aur naam batayenge taki verify kar saken
items.text: mai aapko apna account number aur naam de deta hu

items.context: Aapko kya karna hai is situation me
items.text: kya mujhe complaint lodge karna padega iske liye
ranjit singh ke naam se mera account hai aur 15 march ko bin bataye paise kat gaye
maine apne atm card ko kabhi kisi ko nahi diya fir bhi mumbai me transaction hua hai
mera address lucknow hai aur yahan ki transaction history me aisa kuch dikh raha hai jo galat hai
person jo paise transfer kar raha hai uska naam mukesh mehta dikh raha hai par main use nahi janta
kya main apne bank branch jakar ya call ke through complaint kar sakta hu bina branch ke
jo amount kat gaya hai wo pachaas hazaar hai aur wo mere monthly salary ka part tha
please mere account ki security check karo aur wo transaction turant rok do

items.context: Kya aapko pata hai ki transaction kab hua tha
items.text: ye transaction 12 april ko hua hai aur main mera account check kar raha tha

items.context: Kis tarah ke documents chahiye honge humari investigation ke liye
items.text: kya main apne id proof aur address proof bhej kar is violation ki janch karwa sakta hu

items.context: Kya aapke aas paas kisi aur ko bhi aise transactions ki problem hui hai
items.text: mere dost ne bhi ye bataya ki uske account se bhi bank call kar raha hai similar paise katne ke baare me

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: unauthorised_debit - reports a transaction they did not make
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
